Still on track, William. Nothing has shipped yet.

Your Harlo B30 is in batch 4 and ships the week of November 14, as Georges confirmed. Your free Power Kit goes out separately as soon as it reaches our warehouse, ahead of the B30, and you'll get its tracking by email.

You can follow the incoming batches here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Anything else I can check for you?
